original_semantics.meaning: Wait patiently for Rust commands; scoped fix and final fmt run from codex-rs. Do not kill Rust by PID. Do not re-run tests after fix or fmt.
working-directory is codex-rs; fix delegates to cargo clippy --fix --tests --allow-dirty; fmt delegates to python3 ../scripts/format.py on Unix.
Unix adapter replaces the variadic argument placeholder with quoted positional arguments and execs sh; each supplied option/package remains an argument.

--base resolves the exact commit and compares its tree to the current working tree, plus untracked nonignored files. Without --base, the revision is HEAD and already committed changes disappear from the scope. This is not a merge-base or three-dot comparison. Existing language/config-scope selection remains unchanged.

prerequisites: Root selects the actual final candidate only after the preceding intended validation runs have real terminal results. This document schedules no test or H operation.
Record the real source SHA/tree and require the intended clean worktree before the first maintenance command. Preserve all prior validation source pins and results unchanged.
Read back the four original semantic file pins and the exact baseline commit; a mismatch requires reviewing the actual recipes, not silently treating these pins as current.
Use the existing approved toolchain, target and environment. Do not add budgets, environment overrides, authority, installers, replacement formatter commands or automatic retries.

commands.role: Scoped linter repairs; --tests selects test targets for Clippy, not a new native test run.
Final formatting includes committed PR changes since the exact fixed baseline, as well as any real local edits from fix.

per_command: real source snapshot before and after
actual direct process identity and terminal return code
complete original stdout and stderr bytes, sizes and SHA-256
per_changed_source_path: original tracked blob pin or explicit absent preimage
complete actual postimage bytes at each phase, with size/SHA-256/Git blob ID
explicit deletion or rename endpoints; do not fabricate bytes for absent files
stable identity/readback verification; do not export ignored build artifacts as source postimages
recording.crucial_tree_rule: HEAD and HEAD^{tree} still identify the committed pre-maintenance tree while local source files are dirty. Record that dirty state and the complete postimages; never call the unchanged HEAD tree a formatted source snapshot.
recording.postimage_publication: If files changed, Root reviews and publishes all actual postimages as a separately identifiable commit/tree, then verifies canonical blobs/tree and final checkout status. No final SHA/tree is invented here. If bytes did not change, record the verified unchanged tree and clean status.
recording.raw_log_rule: Save each direct command return code separately. Do not replace it with a pipe/tee exit or normalize a nonzero to success. Any formatter group's original reported exit/output stays in the original aggregate log.
recording.sequencing: Start fmt only after fix has an actual recorded terminal result and its postimages are preserved. Unknown execution does not authorize advancing or retrying. A later fmt exit zero cannot erase a nonzero fix result.

provenance.validation_before_maintenance: Remains evidence for the exact original tested SHA/tree.
provenance.changed_source_after_maintenance: Report maintenance command outcomes and the real new bytes/commit. Do not transplant prior test passes to the new SHA.
provenance.unchanged_source_after_maintenance: Explicit byte/tree equality is required before describing the source as unchanged.
provenance.after_maintenance_tests: None are invoked or scheduled by this contract, as required by AGENTS and Root.
